stem: Which table best describes the behavior of the light ray as it encounters the materials?

options.label: A
options.text: Material 1: The light ray is scattered in all directions. Material 2: The light ray is refracted.

options.label: B
options.text: Material 1: The light ray is absorbed. Material 2: The light ray is reflected.

options.label: C
options.text: Material 1: The light ray is transmitted. Material 2: The light ray is refracted.

options.label: D
options.text: Material 1: The light ray is refracted. Material 2: The light ray is reflected.

visual_elements: Drawing of a light ray passing through Material 1 and reflecting off Material 2
